correctness.rationale: For all finite Q, exact expansion gives P_ij=h*a_ij-h²*Delta_ij/2 and P_ii>=1/2. A maximal-rate diagonal exceeds one above 2/M, forcing a finite negative offdiagonal edge. These formulas prove the single positivity interval, the edge minimum, sharp bounds, and iff equality criterion without missing cases (including Q=0, absorbing states and zero links). The packaged rational checker passed 39240 supplemental assertion groups on varied directed generators and stars; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

The novel claim is the complete directed-weighted generator classification and necessary-and-sufficient equality motif; the polynomial itself is standard.

value.rationale: A complete and computable exact positivity certificate for every finite Markov generator, not a small example: safe timestep from local directed one- and two-hop rates; topology/rate necessary-and-sufficient criterion for when SSP coefficient one is genuinely sharp; and an explicit star sequence approaching twice the usual step limit. These structural properties can inform positivity-preserving timestep selection. No claim of accuracy improvement or stagewise safety is made.
